# Local PowerPoint export library

- Library: [PptxGenJS](https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS)
- Version: 4.0.1
- Bundle: `pptxgen.bundle.js`
- License: MIT, included in `PPTXGENJS-LICENSE.txt`
- Import library: [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip), version 3.10.1, `jszip.min.js`
- JSZip license: MIT/GPL-3.0 dual license, included in `JSZIP-LICENSE.txt`

The app loads both browser libraries locally so PPTX import/export works without a package install or CDN fetch. Web fonts and automatic Commons photo search still use the internet. Library licenses apply to their respective bundles; the design templates and app code remain separate.
